posts.subject: Bug in Dream Knife Server
posts.bodyHtml: I have bought the goron mask and it wont work. I have relogged loads, changed map and everything. I tried to unequip and reequip but it doesnt work because it doesnt let me unequip. Please help because i spent 5000 credits on the goron mask.I got all my credits from someone who gave lots and from playing loads. This is no joke.

Don't worry, we will look into the matter. We apologize if it takes longer than usual, a lot of people are currently on vacation.
